# PodGen Fork

Customized fork of the original [PodGen](https://github.com/th0truth/podgen) podcast episodes generator service.

## Key Features
- **Tailored Enhancements**: Optimized backend configurations and custom environment setup scripts.
- **Enhanced LLM Prompts**: Refined prompts for alternative podcast title and description generation.
- **Telegram Bot Integration**: Customized Telegram API hooks to deliver automated subscription notifications.

## Tech Stack
- **FastAPI / Python**
- **Docker & Docker Compose**
- **MkDocs Material**
